description: Utility functions for handling UAE-specific tax calculations, general ledger entries, and reverse charge logic in ERPNext.

methods.name: update_itemised_tax_data
methods.description: Calculates and updates tax data for each item in a document based on itemised tax details.

methods.name: get_account_currency
methods.description: Retrieves the currency for a given account, using cache or default company currency.

methods.name: get_tax_accounts
methods.description: Fetches UAE VAT tax accounts for a specific company.

methods.name: update_grand_total_for_rcm
methods.description: Adjusts total amounts in the document when reverse charge is applicable.

methods.name: update_totals
methods.description: Updates grand total values in the document after tax adjustments.

methods.name: make_regional_gl_entries
methods.description: Creates region-specific general ledger entries for UAE.

methods.name: make_gl_entry
methods.description: Generates a single GL entry for a tax, considering account currency and tax type.

methods.name: validate_returns
methods.description: Validates that standard rated expenses are not set when reverse charge is applicable.
